FREQUENTLY ASKED Frequently asked questions about commercial lending data. What is automated financial spreading? Automated financial spreading is the process of pulling a borrower's financial statements directly from their accounting system, standardizing them to a common chart of accounts, and feeding them into a credit decisioning model. Validis automates the entire spreading step, eliminating manual rekeying and version-control issues during origination. How does Validis support covenant monitoring? Validis delivers fresh borrower financials on a monthly, quarterly or on-demand cadence, standardized to one common data model. Covenant tests run against the latest source-of-record data automatically. No back-and-forth with the borrower for fresh exports. Compatible with covenant monitoring platforms and internal credit systems. How fresh is the borrower data Validis provides? Validis pulls data directly from the borrower's source accounting system, so the data is as fresh as the borrower's own books. Connection refreshes can be scheduled daily, weekly, monthly, or triggered on-demand. No waiting on a borrower-prepared export. What accounting systems do commercial lending borrowers use? Most commercial lending borrowers use QuickBooks, Xero, Sage (50, 200, Intacct), NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics or FreeAgent. Validis connects to all of these plus 100+ other systems, covering both SMB and mid-market segments. Cloud and on-premise systems are both supported. Get started Faster decisions. Same governance.
